Snow Report

Welcome to Lost Trail

Snow Report for November 23, 2026 9:00 am
👋 Welcome back, Lost Trail family. For everyone that has been peeking in and wondering what the weather has been doing up here, the answer is we are covered in snow 🎉❄️. The last storm left us with 8-10" across the mountain, and temps have stayed cold and the sun has stayed away. Thanksgiving Day is shaping up to be our next best chance for snow, so gobble down that turkey and bust out your best snow dance 🦃💃. Now is the time to wax and sharpen those skis and locate your RFID card. Lost Trail will be open before you know it and you don't want to miss a beat - stay tuned 🎿🤞.

Plan your visit to Lost Trail today

Whether you’re taking your family out skiing for the first time, racing friends down the mountain, going lone wolf, or getting on the slopes after taking a break, we are committed to keeping skiing and snowboarding affordable and accessible to all. We have a variety of lift tickets, season passes, lessons, and rental options available so you can choose your own adventure.
